issues.description: The solution implementation declares toString() with the return type Object (public Object toString()), while the problem description and Java's expected toString() contract require a String return type. This prevents a valid @Override of Object.toString(), will cause a compilation error, and conflicts with the task which expects a String-formatted description.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() method signature in the solution to return String (public String toString()) and ensure the method returns a String. Keep the @Override annotation. Also ensure the template and any examples describe toString() as returning a String so students implement it correctly.
